title: Business Analyst - Exciting Greenfield Project
text: Business Analyst - Exciting Greenfield Project at Private Advertiser (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). A very well-known Australian e-Commerce Company has a rare opportunity for a Business Analyst to join their new division. The Company will be growing their Sydney based technology team as they get ready to work on this exciting and innovative Greenfield Project. The project is a key strategic initiative for this Company so there will be lots of focus to make sure the team that make up this division have what they need! Details on the role and person are listed below; more around the project will be shared through the interview process. As a Business Analyst you role will: Work with stakeholders and clients to gather and analyse functional and non-functional requirements, translating them into agile user stories for Technology and readily consumable artefacts for consumption by the business and clients. End to end business analysis responsibilities from project concept/ start-up phase through to delivery. Facilitate business requirements and process mapping workshops, documenting current and future state processes, documenting business requirements (functional and non-functional), producing business and client facing documents (incl. procedure documents, user manuals, etc.), developing business test cases and running business testing Promote collaboration, knowledge transfer, and skills transfer Lead workshops with key stakeholders to document user stories and develop acceptance tests Carry out cost benefit analysis for a variety of project activities Apply Agile best practise to manage and prioritise the product backlog and improve organisational productivity. Negotiate requirements dependencies with other teams, reprioritising as appropriate, together with the Project Managers. Engage stakeholders and promote deliverables to the business and clients through presentations and product update materials Gather and analyse data in relation to R&D, resource utilisation and other reporting and compliance or audit requirements for the business To be right for the role you will have: Minimum five years Business Analyst experience Experience with production of requirements and Statement of Work documentation for client review and signoff. Agile/SCRUM expertise Good awareness of emerging technologies Strong analysis skills Highly developed written and verbal communication skills Very high attention to detail Strong stakeholder engagement skills Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work as part of a team Proficiency with MS Office suite (including Word, Visio and Excel) Experience with security policies (PCI/DSS) Prior experience with Jira and Confluence As part of our team, you will: Work for a well-known Company in a challenging and complex environment Work with the latest technologies Have the opportunity to work on some career defining projects Join a team of individuals that are open, thoughtful, respectful, experienced, motivated, and successful Pursue quality and excellence in a fast paced industry. Demonstrate credibility as you represent the team, the business and the brand through all your interactions. Be adaptable, able to mould to an ever changing environment. Have the proven ability to problem solve, both being able to think of, and implement innovative solutions to everyday problems. Have well developed time management skills with the ability to deal with conflicting deadlines. Possess a keen eye for detail whilst demonstrating a sense of urgency in delivery. Be able to quickly establish rapport and develop client relationships with a variety of stakeholders. Be a team player willing to strive to deliver exceptional results. While with our organisation your hard work in helping change the way we interact with our customers will not go unrewarded. We support and reward great performance by offering competitive salaries, employee benefits and incentives. Please apply with a full current C.V. and our recruitment team will be in touch with you immediately for a confidential discussion.
